The record must name たまり醤油 explicitly and say it is NOT a gluten-free soy sauce, or a reader will do the substitution themselves. gf_confidence:no is unaffected — both bowls are wheat 中華そば noodles and the curry uses wheat roux.

why: SHUT SINCE 2026-07-19 — one month before this sweep, and the record still shows 'Tue-Sun 10:00-15:00, 16:00-19:00' as if open. Precise status: 無期限休業 (indefinite suspension), which the operator explicitly distinguishes from 廃業; I am filing it as closed_permanently so the record is hidden, because there is no reopening date and the operator says reopening is currently not feasible. Kyotopi interviewed the company president (article dated 2026-06-11): 「そんな同店が、2026年7月19日（日）をもって無期限休業することがわかりました。」 Cause: 「休業の大きな要因のひとつが建物の老朽化です…近年の原材料費や光熱費などの高騰も重なり」. Future: 「営業体制は梅小路エリアにある『ますたに梅小路店』へ集約する方針です」 and on reopening 「『いつか再開したい気持ちはある』としながらも…現時点では難しい」. Independently corroborated on Tabelog by two reviewers who queued for the final days (「✅26/7/19をもって無期限長期休業」; 「今週末7/19(日)をもって長期休業に入るとの報が入ったのが約1ヶ月前…この日開店15分前の9時45分に到着で69番目」) and by a change.org petition opened 2026-07-07 asking the shop to keep trading. Note for whoever hides this: the SISTER branch ますたに梅小路店 is still open and is where the business has been consolidated — do not let this closure propagate to it. Also note the cited kyotopi review article (2022) and the Tabelog listing still print live-looking hours; the kyugyo article gives the final hours as 10:00〜14:45 / 16:00〜17:45, 定休日 月曜・第三水曜, which is where the record's 'some sources list 10:00–14:45 and 16:00–17:45' came from.

BUT THE RECORD'S WEBSITE IS A DEAD DOMAIN: https://mimiox.org/ is NXDOMAIN (Google DNS 8.8.8.8: 'Non-existent domain'; curl: 'Could not resolve host'). It has not lapsed into casino content — it simply resolves to nothing — but it is a broken link on a live record and should be replaced with the Tabelog listing. The Wayback capture (https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://mimiox.org/) shows the site was last touched in 2021 and advertised hours 11:30-14:30 / 17:30-22:30, which are NOT the current hours; anyone reviving that citation would publish wrong opening times. History note so a later sweep does not misread it: the Gion original (opened 2000-01-03) closed and the shop MOVED to Yoshida in March 2016 — Tabelog's 「※このお店は以前の場所から移転しています」 banner refers to that move, not to a closure.
